Persons with JA may perseverate which is a fancy word for "the repetition of a particular response (such as a word, phrase, or gesture) regardless of the absence or cessation of a stimulus" which could be a conversation or a speech.

JA is usually caused by a brain injury or other organic disorders. Symptoms include the inability to transition or switch ideas appropriately within the social context. This could present as the repetition of words or gestures after they have ceased to be socially relevant or appropriate.

The individual is unable to shift goals, activities or tasks as required in a normal social setting and/or carries on (rambles) in the absence of the original stimulus.
